div.div: 2 تلّد , (IAar, T, K,) inf. n. تَتْلِيدٌ; (K;) or ↓ تَلَدَ ; (so in the L as on the authority of IAar, and accord. to Lh as is said in the TA;) i. q. جَمَعَ and مَنَعَ [app. as meaning He collected and defended property]; (IAar, T, L, K;) said of a man. (IAar, T, L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
